card.name: Slot where a list item or addition continues
card.fires_on: Small joining words or punctuation (comma, 'or', 'of', '=') that sit inside a series or compound phrase and are about to be followed by another item. Seen in drug-label lists of risk factors and in Python code or mailing-list talk.

modes.label: Lists of risk factors
modes.description: A comma or 'or' inside a list of conditions or situations, just before the next item.
modes.example: Strenuous exercise<<,>> exposure to extreme heat, dehydration, and

modes.label: Therapy start or change
modes.description: The word 'following' after 'initiation of therapy or', before 'a dosage increase'.
modes.example: the risk is greatest during the initiation of therapy or<< following>> a dosage increase.

modes.label: Python and code talk
modes.description: Assignment sign or short words in programming discussion about methods and assignment.

card.writes: It leans toward code-style append and add-to operators (addAll, +=, unshift) and away from words like formation and stroke.
card.plain: It fires on the small joining word or comma in the middle of a list, right before the next item comes in.
